issue.title: 3日ごとの定期改善レポートメールを本稼働設定

summary: Complete the timezone-aware three-day report claim, Agent analysis, customer UI, Cloudflare email delivery, retry, subscription, and staging evidence flow.
decisions: Cloud Scheduler starts the hourly Cloud Run Job; DB next_run_at and idempotent claim determine due workspaces.
Missing/expired Google data produces a reconnect notice, not fabricated analysis.
Email contains a summary and product link; detailed report stays in the authenticated application.
requirementRefs: REQUIREMENTS.md#7-3日ごとの改善レポート

risks.description: Concurrent jobs may deliver the same period more than once.
risks.mitigation: Use unique idempotency key plus conditional claim and delivery state tests.

risks.description: The Agent may analyze unavailable data.
risks.mitigation: Gate generation on scoped provider data and switch to reconnect/data-insufficient content.
Retry only 429/5xx with a maximum; record 4xx as terminal.

gates.description: Approve and configure the dedicated sending domain and reports sender.
Approve staging Scheduler/Job and external email execution.

acceptanceCriteria: A workspace is claimed once per three-day period at 09:00 in its timezone.
Retries are bounded; only 429/5xx retry and 4xx becomes terminal.
Data insufficiency/auth expiry produces reconnect content with no invented KPI.
Minimum report includes human procedure and locked write/chat CTA; other plans use their entitlements.
HTML/plain delivery, per-user unsubscribe, queue, and bounce evidence pass staging.
Report usage is separate from chat quota.

rollback.strategy: Pause Scheduler/Job, retain report rows, disable sends, and keep the authenticated report history readable.
rollback.verification: No new claims or email attempts occur after pause and existing report/audit rows remain intact.
